domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record was retrieved. thecompanycheck.com, volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so no domestic-supply record could be read. The only India-side trace is the buyer role in import customs entries (goods landed at Delhi Air Cargo for this Okhla consignee), which evidences purchasing, not supplying.
note: Company exists and is clearly active as an importer/distributor of electronic components (ICs, connectors, voltage regulators) at Okhla Industrial Area Phase-I, Delhi — 20,603 customs records, 86 trading partners, 47 port lanes, latest record 2026-02-28. However, the declared HS code 870899 (motor-vehicle parts) does not match the observed trade: the visible records carry HS 85423900 (integrated circuits) and 85366990 (connectors), i.e. electronics, not auto parts. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual 85423900/85366990. On Rule 5: no export shipment of this company was found in any accessible source, and no domestic supply evidence (GST turnover, GeM/CPPP, contracts) could be retrieved because all four company-data portals blocked access. So: 'следов экспортных поставок не найдено'; domestic supply status is unknown, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the sources reachable. Role: trader/distributor (imports components and resells), not a manufacturer.
